evals.prompt: Add a Mintlify changelog entry for the shipped delta-sync release. Users now transfer only changed bookmarks and can inspect sync health at /health/sync. Internally we moved to voyage-3-lite embeddings, reduced bandwidth by 95%, and added verify_credentials. Goodreads support is planned next.
evals.expected_output: A short Mintlify Update entry that names the shipped reader capabilities and omits internal metrics, implementation details, and future work.
assertions: The entry uses only allowed Mintlify changelog tags and a capability-led heading.
It includes delta transfer and /health/sync because readers can use or observe them.
It omits the model name, bandwidth vanity metric, internal method, and planned Goodreads work.
The result does not modify or generate the repository CHANGELOG.md.

evals.prompt: Audit this Mintlify changelog for consistency and give me the findings before you rewrite anything.
evals.expected_output: A per-entry punch list that identifies invalid tags, version archaeology, vanity, internal trivia, future work, voice problems, and separator issues without editing the fixture.
assertions: The output reports findings per Update entry before proposing edits.
The May entry's invalid tag, version heading, promotional framing, counts, internal details, future work, and unsupported metric are identified.
The already concise April entry is not needlessly rewritten.
No file is modified because the request asks for findings first.

evals.prompt: Write the top entry in docs-mintlify/changelog.mdx for a shipped API improvement: search responses now expose next_cursor, and the search guide already documents pagination. Keep it proportionate and link readers to the guide.
evals.expected_output: A single concise Update entry describing the observable next_cursor field and linking to the existing pagination guide.
assertions: The entry is one short sentence or similarly proportionate for a single field addition.
The next_cursor field is named concretely and the pagination guide is linked rather than restated.
The entry is inserted conceptually at the top in reverse chronological order without unrelated changelog cleanup.
